question: Which unexpected celebrity couple has the internet losing it?
story: TikTok's biggest star might be dating a Formula One world champion, and the whole thing reportedly started at a race. If you are not on TikTok, Alix Earle is basically its queen, millions of people hang on her every get ready with me. Lando Norris is the British McLaren driver who finally became a world champion. According to multiple reports, the two first sparked dating rumors back in June, when Earle turned up at the Monaco Grand Prix, and were later spotted together in Cannes. Then earlier this month, cameras caught them leaving a private members club in London well after midnight. Sources tell outlets like AOL and Just Jared that they have been on several dates and are, quote, really into each other, though insiders say it is still too early to call it official. Neither one has actually confirmed a thing. From the racetrack to the tabloids in record time.
